selection_rule: Attila factors cubic income products; quadratic objectives keep the expanded Boolean model. WRE/Saxon factored candidate timings below motivated this rule. Rome II uses exact integer linearization with slot/branch product cuts.
method: Sequential baseline/revised runs on one machine, CP-SAT seed 0, four workers. Original Rome II uses the unchanged canonical native integer-product model; original Attila uses the same BinaryModel with cp_sat_plan disabled. Candidate factored Attila runs deliberately include quadratic models to compare formulations before choosing the automatic rule. Final automatic runs use the full TUI subprocess path without a time limit or worker override. Each returned layout is checked by the original economic evaluator; Attila also checks the expanded constraint matrix.
